_comment: Command `<COM>_Join` kojo (Plan_KojoTemplates.md §7.11): the act's doer, then its receiver, react when someone joins (EvaluationPackage.LogMessage_Join; listener = the joiner; not while the doer is time-stopped). Accepted joins only: a refused join belongs in `<COM>_JoinFailed` (template commandJoinFailed; the engine call is not wired yet), so refuse branches here are errors. Not the joiner's own keys (_Tryjoin / _Joined / _Join_Refused).
label: 参与者对加入者的反应（加入成功）
_comment_speakers: Only the EP's doer and receiver react (LogMessage_Join), the listener is the joiner: a doer + receiver split (alone: a doer branch) covers every speaker, so no generic fallback is needed after it.
_comment_required: fallback: the role branch must be a fallback for that role with these fields. No awareness gate before the lookup (LogMessage_Join → JoinReaction): a receiver that can't act (asleep, unconscious …) fails a default receiver branch (requireSelfAction true) and would fall through to the generic fallback, written for an awake speaker. Its unaware lines go in speaker-status children of the receiver branch.
